about_the_game:
This is a demo version of HUNTER×HUNTER NEN×IMPACT.

In the demo version, you can enjoy the following modes with some characters: ・Free battle ・Training mode ・Story (tutorial only)

Free Battle

・Training Mode

・Story (Tutorial only)

*Save data from the demo version cannot be transferred to the main “HUNTER×HUNTER NEN×IMPACT” game.
